facts.fact: Newsreel Zimbabwe reports that Minister Kazembe said an Electronic Crime Management System developed by Array Institute of Technology with the ZRP IC team has a prototype being tested at Warren Park Police Station.

Newsreel Zimbabwe reports that Minister Kazembe said a Zimbabwe Republic Police Integrated Information Management System Strategy has been developed, comprising the Crime Management System, Forensic Laboratory Management System and Electronic Traffic Management System.
facts.system: ZRP Integrated Information Management System Strategy
